sanskrit_verse:
शुचि गोतृप्तिकृत् तोयं प्रकृतिस्थं महीगतम् ।
तथा मांसं श्वचण्डालक्रव्यादादिनिपातितम् ॥१.१९२॥
transliteration: śuci gotṛptikṛt toyaṃ prakṛtisthaṃ mahīgatam | tathā māṃsaṃ śvacaṇḍālakravyādādinipātitam ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Pure water offered in satisfaction of the cow, remaining in its natural state upon the earth, and likewise flesh fallen from the body of a dog, outcaste, or kravyāda, is not to be touched.
jurisprudential_principles: Capacity-based responsibility is determined by ontological alignment

Consciousness alignment requires rejection of degraded substances

IF water_offered_to_cow == TRUE AND location == earth THEN touching_prohibited = TRUE
IF ontological_status(substance) < threshold(purity) THEN engagement_allowed = FALSE ELSE engagement_allowed = CONTEXTUAL

nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that degradation transfers through direct causal contact. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows contamination manifests sequentially through touch, ingestion, or absorption. Responsibility lies in conscious avoidance, not punitive consequence.
